stages.title: THREE-TERM SPINE

pills.text: THREE-TERM SPINE
SAME RULES, SAME RIGHTS, OUTCOME-NEUTRAL TREATMENT (ARTICLES 14, 15(1)
DIFFERENTIATED INSTRUMENTS ENABLED BY ARTICLE 15(3) TO OFFSET UNEQUAL
MEASURED EXPANSION OF AGENCY, CAPABILITY AND VOICE
NAMING A SCHEME PROVES EQUITY WAS ATTEMPTED, NOT THAT
MUST REMEMBER
GENDER JUSTICE ADDRESSES BODILY AUTONOMY, VIOLENCE, HEALTH, EDUCATION

sequence: EQUALITY → same rules, same rights, outcome-neutral treatment (Articles 14, 15(1), 16)

EMPOWERMENT: measured expansion of agency, capability and voice
